hook: A 51-year record fell when Pakistan hit 89 final-wicket runs.

sections.voiceover: A 51-year record fell when Pakistan hit 89 final-wicket runs.
On October 25, 2026, Pakistan chased England's total of 241 in Lahore. How's Pakistan going to chase down England's total of 241 at Gaddafi Stadium?
b_roll: map of Lahore highlighting Gaddafi Stadium

sections.voiceover: Except Shadab Khan and Haris Rauf survived 80 tense balls together.
Shadab Khan struck a superb unbeaten 113 off 96 balls. That epic effort delivered a stunning one-wicket victory over England.
b_roll: graphic showing 113 runs off 96 balls stat card

sections.voiceover: Their 89-run 10th-wicket partnership shattered a record that'd lasted 51 years in Lahore.
